other_conditions: Applicant must be a permanent resident of Assam
Applicant must be engaged in any building & other construction work
Applicant must be registered with the Assam Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board
The worker must have continuous membership for 5 years
Benefit is available for the marriage of two children of the beneficiary
A female registered member is also eligible for her own marriage
benefits_summary: Financial assistance of ₹25,000 per beneficiary for the marriage of two children, and also for a female worker’s own marriage.
